name: When should I consider replacing my siding instead of just repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my siding instead of just repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repair and replacement depends on the extent of damage and overall condition. If only a few panels are damaged, repairing them is usually more cost-effective. However, if damage is widespread across multiple sections, such as extensive cracking, warping, or dry rot affecting a large portion of the home, replacement becomes the more sensible option. Signs of structural compromise, recurring moisture issues, or a desire to significantly improve energy efficiency or curb appeal can also warrant a full replacement. A professional inspection can help determine the most economical and effective long-term solution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace siding when damage is widespread, structural integrity is compromised, or you want significant upgrades. Repair is better for isolated issues.
